f.title: Pre-July 2012 authorisations without set frequency: PSURs 6-monthly, then yearly, then 3-yearly, or on request
f.statement: For authorisations granted before 21 July 2012 that do not specify PSUR frequency and dates (and for products authorised in only one EEA State outside the EURD list), PSURs must be submitted immediately on request of the Agency or the Board, or: before marketing, at least every 6 months after authorisation until placing on the market; after marketing, at least every 6 months during the first 2 years after initial placing on the market, once a year for the next 2 years and at three-yearly intervals thereafter; until another frequency or a Union reference date is set.
f.applicability: Authorisations granted before 21 July 2012 without set PSUR frequency; products authorised in only one EEA State not covered by Art 107c(4)-(7)
